title: Wake Up From Dying 發惡夢取代死亡
description: Wake up from a bad dream instead of dying!
body:
# Wake Up From Dying
---
---
---

# About 關於


Instead of dying, players will wake up from a bad dream during a middle of a thunderstorm.

玩家不會死亡，而是在雷雨中從惡夢中醒來。

---

This datapack basically changes a few gamerules :

這個指令包改變了一些遊戲規則：

  - doImmediateRespawn
  ⁠- keepInventory
  - showDeathMessages

---

This datapack changed "Totem of Undying" to "Dream Catcher Totem" (v1.1)

This datapack also added other features, such as visual and audio effects of waking up from a bad dream, and an advancement.

這個數據包還添加了其他功能，例如從惡夢中醒來的視覺效果和音效以及成就。

---
# Instructions 說明


This datapack is loaded automatically. 

此指令包會自動載入。

---

Due to technical issue, the loaded message will not show up when loaded in the first place, it will be shown when /reload is used.

由於技術問題，載入訊息在第一次載入時不會顯示，只有在使用 /reload 時才會顯示。

---
